messages:
kelly-sales: FYI Lantern is ready to run a POC to migrate off VendorX -> Redwood. Main asks: prompt parity, token billing alignment, security questionnaire answered. Can we sketch an ops plan this week?

ravi-eng: TL;DR we need sample payloads, their current model + params, and latency SLOs. also any existing adapter code they have.

kelly-sales: I have a couple sample calls from Lantern (scrubbed) — https://s3.redwood/internal/labs/lantern/poc-samples.tar.gz. Latency target is p95 < 250ms for chat completions.

jordana-ml: For prompt parity we should run a diff-suite: identical prompts -> compare tokenized outputs, embedding distance, and hallucination checks. I can spin up an eval harness if we get their prompt corpus.

seyra-sec: Security checklist first pass: SSO/SAML support, customer-managed KMS, audit logs retention, VPC peering or private endpoints, data residency, and SOC2 evidence. Lantern will send a 20p questionnaire.

ben-sales: Pricing question from Lantern: do we recommend Dedicated reserved units for cost parity or can hosted w/ batching meet their economics? they want an estimate for 6mo commit.

ravi-eng: Recommend starting with hosted + optimized batching + KV cache for LLM sessions to prove functional parity. If costs look high after smoke tests we propose migrating to Dedicated. I can produce an estimate from our cost model with their qps.

kelly-sales: can you run estimation if Lantern expects 40 req/s with avg 600 tokens per session? want ballpark before tomorrow call.

ravi-eng: on it. rough calc: 40 * 600 = 24k tokens/s -> per-hour = 86.4M tokens. I'll model hosted vs 8x A100 reserved baseline and post numbers.

jordana-ml: On the response-side, small formatting differences may appear. propose we add a compatibility shim that: 1) normalizes whitespace, 2) maps vendor tool-calls to our function schema, 3) canonicalizes assistant labels. Sample map below:

```json
{"vendor_tool":"open_fn.execute","redwood_tool":"run_action","args_map":{"input":"payload"}}
```

kelly-sales: good — Lantern flagged tool-calls as biggest source of breakage. we should include that in acceptance criteria.

seyra-sec: Lantern's legal wants explicit retention times and deletion workflow. we need to confirm log retention windows and support for on-demand purge via API. also they asked about egress IPs for firewall allowlist.

ravi-eng: We'll provide: list of egress IP ranges, API for data purge (POST /v1/admin/purge), and a canned deletion SLA (48 hrs for host logs). I'll open an internal runbook to implement purge endpoints in staging.

deploy-bot: staging cluster for lantern-poc created (cluster-lantern-staging). image: inference-runtime:v4.2. smoke tests queued.

jordana-ml: I'll load Lantern prompts into eval harness and run: token-delta, embed-cosine, and answer-accuracy against their golden set. Expected outputs: token delta < 5% and embedding cosine > 0.92 for pass.

ben-sales: Lantern also needs a short memo for procurement: scope, duration, rollback plan, and cost estimate. Can someone draft it?

kelly-sales: I'll draft the memo and include the canary rollback plan Ravi suggested. Meeting w/ Lantern tomorrow 10am PT. Anyone who wants to join?

ravi-eng: joining. will bring cost estimates and canary script.

seyra-sec: joining for the security Qs.

jordana-ml: joining for eval criteria.

kelly-sales: great — action items: Ravi -> cost calc + egress IPs; Jordana -> eval run + pass thresholds; Seyra -> quick answer doc for SAML/KMS/retention; Ben -> procurement memo template. I'll follow up with Lantern invite.

ben-sales: ack. once memo is ready I'll route to procurement.

kelly-sales: thanks team. keeping this thread for POC sync and postmortem notes.

deploy-bot: smoke tests completed: 12/15 checks passed. failures: tool-call serialization mismatch. See logs: https://staging.redwood/logs/lantern-smoke/1758881234

jordana-ml: noted failure. I'll add normalization for tool-call payloads and re-run.

ravi-eng: re: billing parity — initial estimate attached in the drive folder (internal). will post summary in this thread after numbers finalized.

kelly-sales: perfect. closing loop after tomorrow's call.
